# Extract all "switch partners" operations (ignoring "discuss" and "nothing happens" lines)
switches_text = re.findall(r'(\w+) and (\w+) switch partners', text)

# Initial partnerships
partners = {
    'Alice': 'Izzi',
    'Bob': 'Jamie',
    'Claire': 'Ophelia',
    'Dave': 'Rodrigo',
    'Eve': 'Patrick',
    'Fred': 'Sam',
    'Gertrude': 'Lola'
}

def switch_partners(partners, person1, person2):
    """When person1 and person2 switch partners, they exchange their current partners"""
    p1_partner = partners[person1]
    p2_partner = partners[person2]
    partners[person1] = p2_partner
    partners[person2] = p1_partner

# Apply all switches

    switch_partners(partners, person1, person2)

# Find Bob's partner at the end
